notes: Perfect separation on the load-bearing assertions: every with-skill run stopped at the confirm-before-generate gate (0 .java files across all 4); every baseline that could generate, did (eval-1: 2 files, eval-2: 4 files on fabricated gear-ratio/motor assumptions).

2 of 12 assertions are non-discriminating FOR BASELINES ONLY: 'hub_generation not asked' (eval-1) and 'gate stays closed' (eval-4) pass trivially when the baseline asks nothing / manages no config. They remain discriminating for with-skill regressions (a with-skill run that ASKS hub_generation in 2025-26 would fail them), so keep them, but read baseline pass-rate on these two as noise.

REAL FINDING from eval-2 with-skill: the season model's per-mechanism annotation 'turret requires shooter != none' is NOT machine-checked by validate_config.py (only declared archetypes are). The agent caught and enforced it by reading the YAML comment — correct behavior, but it relied on model diligence where the suite's own principle says a script should check. Iteration candidate: extend validate_config.py to parse mechanism-level requires annotations.

Eval-3 baseline surfaced the constraint correctly via pure model judgment — but then pre-committed a resolution on the user's behalf instead of asking which side to change. The skill's differentiator here is not 'notices conflicts' (a strong model often does) but 'verified by construction + user decides': the deterministic check fires every time regardless of model diligence, and the flow forbids choosing for the user.

Eval-4 baseline got the SystemCore timeline RIGHT via live web search of tier-1 sources — a strong baseline. The skill's value on this eval is determinism and tier-label preservation (offline, single source of truth, T1/T2/UNCONFIRMED carried through), not raw factual accuracy against a capable searching baseline.

Cost of the discipline: +49.4s and +15.6k tokens per run on average. This is the price of reading the suite files + running the gate; acceptable for a generation-gating skill where the failure it prevents ships to a robot.
